# ShipRules

> ShipRules sells AI coding rules packs (.cursorrules / Cursor `.mdc`, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GitHub Copilot instructions) that stop common AI agent mistakes in specific stacks. Each paid pack ships the same rules in four formats, plus a zero-dependency Node.js scanner and optional Claude Code hooks.

## Free
- [shiprules-free](https://github.com/otctrading101/shiprules-free): MIT starter Cursor rules / CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md for Next.js+Supabase+Stripe (Supabase RLS + Data API GRANTs + Stripe webhook raw-body verification), Unity 6 AI, Godot 4 AI / GDScript 2.0, and discord.js v14
- [cursor.directory listing](https://cursor.directory/plugins/shiprules-free-supabase-rls-stripe-webhook-godot-4-unity-6-discordjs-guardrails): the free rules as one-click "Add to Cursor" entries

## Paid packs (one-time, instant download, single-user commercial license)
- [Ship-Safe SaaS Pack ($15)](https://shiprules.gumroad.com/l/lztkjm): Next.js App Router + Supabase + Stripe. Supabase RLS on every table, explicit Data API GRANTs (42501-safe), server-only service_role key, Stripe webhook `constructEvent` + raw body + idempotency, env/secret handling, Zod validation, pre-ship checklist. Scanner flags leaked keys, missing RLS and unverified webhooks.
- [Unity 6 Agent Pack ($12)](https://shiprules.gumroad.com/l/pegmfk): Unity 6 AI rules — API correctness (FindAnyObjectByType, linearVelocity, linearDamping), hot-path performance, null safety, editor-only code separation, .meta file protection.
- [Godot 4 Pack ($9)](https://shiprules.gumroad.com/l/tawprk): Godot 4 AI / stop Godot 3 code. GDScript 2.0 (@export, @onready, await), 60+ renamed nodes/APIs (KinematicBody2D→CharacterBody2D), signals/Callables; scanner for Godot 3 syntax in .gd/.tscn.
- [Discord Bot Pack ($9)](https://shiprules.gumroad.com/l/qitubq): discord.js v14 (and discord.py 2.x notes). Intents, slash commands, deferReply within 3 seconds, token safety, rate limits, sharding.
- [ShipRules Bundle ($29)](https://shiprules.gumroad.com/l/qgwqqy): all four packs plus future updates. Launch discount: [/l/qgwqqy/LAUNCH30](https://shiprules.gumroad.com/l/qgwqqy/LAUNCH30) (30% off through Oct 22, 2026).

## Notes
- Formats checked against the official Cursor, Claude Code, agents.md and GitHub Copilot docs, and engine facts against Unity 6, Godot 4.7 and discord.js docs (re-checked October 16, 2026).
- Scanners are heuristic safety nets, not compilers or security audits.
